p1.title: Kaching! SaaS POS Ecosystem
p1.problem: Problem: Unstable internet halts cashier transactions, triggering lost revenue queues in F&B.
p1.solution: Solution: An Offline-First SaaS POS architecture. Transactions continue without internet. Once restored, WebSocket Sync automatically updates the kitchen screens (*Kitchen Display System*).
p1.impact: Impact: Total elimination of transaction downtime. Reliable operational sync during rush hours.

p2.title: MBG ERP System
p2.label: Local / Internal
p2.problem: Problem: Mass catering inventory management is highly susceptible to manual stock recording errors and ingredient miscalculations.
p2.solution: Solution: A bespoke ERP system to automate production workflows — from procurement to distribution, featuring a real-time inventory dashboard.
p2.impact: Impact: Suppresses human error. Ensures tight control over ingredient availability for large-scale daily catering operations.

p3.title: Natgrey Business Profile
p3.desc: A premium digital catalog for an architectural lighting brand. Focused on instant load performance, smooth transitions, and a luxurious UI/UX presentation to captivate B2B corporate clients.

p4.title: Car Sales & Inventory
p4.label: Local / Internal
p4.desc: Interactive vehicle listing platform. Equipped with a dynamic search engine and inventory management panel allowing dealers to track their asset units at all times.

p5.title: SmartSAW Decision Logic
p5.desc: Digitization of mathematical decision logic models. Automating the SAW (Simple Additive Weighting) matrix to generate fast, objective, and precise multi-criteria weighting.
